summary: Ran end-to-end tests of Shipready Phase 1 on the public preview URL. Backend: pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_shipready_phase1.py (11 tests, run serially with -n 0). All 11 pass after one test-tooling fix; there was one transient hang in a single run. Coverage: health, openapi, money constants, ship 404s, Q-4 (all /api/desk/* and /api/auth/me return 401 without cookie), wrong secret 'Wrong secret.', checkout idem-key 400/same-key-same-order/slot drop, expire releases slot, bad-sig 400, unknown-pi 200 unresolved, amount/eur/namespace/livemode mismatch books nothing and order stays reserved, paid booking + SR- regex certificate + proof + cert contribution 103809, 5x replay stays 'replay' with 1 charge row (Q-1), dispute -109000 then won gives net 0 with state disputed, full refund gives -5191 contribution + REVOKED + slot back (Q-3), async-failed, sweep with backdated hold, 10 concurrent checkouts never oversell and extras get 409 'sold out' (Q-2), and the REAL Stripe flow (real-pay, Stripe-delivered webhook, desk $100 refund, same request replayed=true with the same refund id, over-remaining request capped to 99000, order refunded, REVOKED, -5191, open +1, further refund 409). Frontend (Playwright): JRN-1 landing, JRN-2/3 store badge + test mode + Take a slot goes to checkout.stripe.com (~2.3s) and the count drops, Sold out. with no button, 404 pages (/s/not-a-ship, /p/SR-NOTREAL00000, random path), proof list and Verified/REVOKED certificate pages, /desk unauth redirects to /access, wrong and correct secret, desk metrics + status panel (webhook URL ends /api/webhooks/stripe, secret set yes, last webhook, unresolved count), Run sweep now, refund dialog partial $100 -> repeat 'replayed' -> capped full refund -> REVOKED $-51.91 and store 2 of 3 open. No horizontal overflow at 390px on /, /s/shipready-sprint, /desk, /proof, /p/:code, /access. Q-6: API checkout latency 0.46-0.52s in 4 of 5 trials and 2.18s once (Must <4000 met, Plan <1500 missed once).

minor.issue: Cloudflare in front of the preview URL returned '403 error code: 1010' to every simulator post, because it blocks the default 'Python-urllib' User-Agent. Every signed-sim journey failed until I added a User-Agent header (fixed). Real Stripe deliveries are not affected. urllib.urlopen also has no timeout, so one sim call hung for more than 60s once (1 of about 60 calls).

The backend sets SameSite=strict (checked via localhost). The preview ingress rewrites it to 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' on the public URL. This is an environment issue, not app code, but the SameSite=Strict requirement cannot be observed on the preview URL.

The refund cap is amount - refunded_cents and ignores disputed_cents (book_dispute does account for refunds). A refund on an order with an open dispute could take ledger debits above the charge amount. This is an edge case and was not exercised.

asyncio.create_task(record_actual_fee(...)) keeps no reference to the task, so it can be garbage-collected. Fees actual showed '0 known' for all orders, including real PIs (the balance transaction may not exist yet at payment time).

ui_bugs.issue: After a refund succeeds, the dialog header still shows the old 'remaining' amount (e.g. $1,090.00 after a $100 refund) until the dialog is reopened. The order prop is a stale snapshot.

issues: The headline is split into three block lines, so the text 'Three slots. One offer. One price.' is not one contiguous text node (innerText has newlines). Visually correct; only a matter for exact-text checks.

action_items: Optional: add a timeout to urllib.urlopen in stripe_sim.py; keep the User-Agent header I added (Cloudflare blocks Python-urllib).
Optional: cap book_refund at amount - refunded - disputed, or document the intended behaviour.
Optional: keep a reference to the record_actual_fee task and/or retry fetching the fee later (fees actual is always 0 known).
Optional: refresh the RefundDialog 'remaining' value after a refund.
critical_code_review_comments: The global asyncio.Lock in ledger serialises webhook processing per process only. Fine for a single uvicorn worker, but it would not protect multiple workers; DB unique op_key/event_id still guard money.
The inbox claim reprocesses a stale 'processing' claim on a duplicate event id, which is acceptable under the LOCK.
Fake checkout.session.expired events expire orders locally but leave the Stripe session open. If it is later paid, book_charge resells or flags over_capacity, which is handled.
server.py is 461 lines and modules are split well; money is in integer cents from a single module.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11; 1 transient sim hang in one run)

seed_data_creation: No seed data was changed. I created TEST_ idem-key orders: all held ones are expired, and two test-mode orders were paid with real PaymentIntents and fully refunded (one via signed sim with a fake PI, one real via the desk UI). The main agent's real order 6afb39fb52e65336214190c9 is untouched (paid, $100 refunded). Final state: test counters sold=1, reserved=0, 2 of 3 open. Desk contribution is now $782.36 because of the extra closed-and-refunded test orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend suite serially: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_shipready_phase1.py -n 0 -v. It needs at least 1 open test slot for most tests (real_refund flow and concurrency adapt to the open count). stripe_sim needs the User-Agent header. JRN-23 (empty /proof state) was NOT tested because certificates exist and deleting them is not allowed. REQ-29 (inbox rollback on exception) was checked by code review only. Login rate limit (10 failures/min -> 429) was not exercised.
rca of the issue: Sim 403: the Cloudflare WAF rule 1010 (browser integrity, UA-based) blocks the Python-urllib UA. Reproduce: curl -A 'Python-urllib/3.11' -X POST <url>/api/webhooks/stripe returns 403. Mitigation: send a non-urllib UA (done).
